info.name: Audio Annotations
info.summary: Timestamped text and voice notes on audio files
info.description:
Review recordings in Nextcloud. Audio files open in a waveform player where you highlight a range and attach a text or voice note to it, or leave a General Comment on the whole recording. Everyone the file is shared with can read the notes, reply and resolve them; notes can also be private. The Files sidebar lists the notes and exports them to Markdown or an Audacity label track.
Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe on the server and background jobs through cron. Recording voice notes needs HTTPS.
info.author: Corbin Keener
